verses.en: By the fig and the olive
And by this land made safe

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏
verses.en: Surely We created man of the best stature
Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونࣲ‏
verses.en: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing
So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment
Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges
